articles.title: Evening with Manchester United Treble Winners Scheduled for October 23 at Middleton Arena
articles.excerpt: Football fans can meet Manchester United legends Andy Cole, Denis Irwin, and David May at Middleton Arena on October 23, 2026, for an evening of stories and insights from their treble-winning season.
articles.content_html:
Football fans will have the opportunity to relive the glory days of Manchester United's treble-winning season during an event at Middleton Arena on October 23, 2026. The evening will feature three key figures from the record-breaking 1998-1999 squad: Andy Cole, Denis Irwin, and David May.

The event, titled 'An Evening With The Treble Winners', will be hosted by Alan Keegan, known as the voice of Old Trafford. Attendees can expect to hear personal anecdotes and insights from the players who played pivotal roles in Sir Alex Ferguson's successful campaign, which included winning the Premier League, FA Cup, and UEFA Champions League.

Middleton Arena has described the event as a unique chance to engage with football icons, stating, "Three icons. One night. A lifetime of Old Trafford glory in the spotlight." Fans will be treated to interviews and stories that highlight the behind-the-scenes moments that defined one of football's greatest eras.

Tickets for this special evening are expected to be in high demand, offering a rare chance for supporters to connect with the legends of Manchester United. Further details on ticket availability and pricing will be announced closer to the event date.

articles.title: Northern Care Alliance Declares Critical Incident Ahead of Strikes
articles.excerpt: The Northern Care Alliance NHS Foundation Trust has declared a critical incident as over 350 workers prepare to strike at hospitals including Rochdale Infirmary, impacting surgeries and treatments.
articles.content_html:
The Northern Care Alliance NHS Foundation Trust (NCA) has declared a critical incident in response to upcoming strikes by healthcare workers. The strikes, involving more than 350 staff members, are scheduled to take place at Salford Royal Hospital, Royal Oldham Hospital, Rochdale Infirmary, and Fairfield Hospital in Bury on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday of this week.

The decision to declare a critical incident aims to secure additional support to maintain urgent surgical services, although some procedures will be postponed. The strikes are part of an ongoing dispute over pay related to staffing shortages, with Unison indicating a willingness to negotiate with the trust.

The NCA has apologised for the disruption this may cause to patients and has assured that those affected by changes to their surgery, treatment, or appointments will be contacted directly. Patients are advised not to call the hospitals to check on their appointments, as the trust will reach out to them.

This critical incident declaration highlights the ongoing challenges faced by the NHS in Greater Manchester, particularly in light of staffing issues and the impact of industrial action on healthcare services. The situation will be monitored closely as the strikes proceed.

articles.title: Two Women Arrested After Three-Year-Old Boy Falls from Window in Rochdale
articles.excerpt: A three-year-old boy is in critical condition after falling from a first-floor window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale. Two women, aged 19 and 20, have been arrested on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child.
articles.content_html:
BREAKING NEWS — LIVE

Live updates, newest first.

18:27, 23 August 2026

A three-year-old boy is in critical condition after falling from a first-floor window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale. Two women, aged 19 and 20, have been arrested on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child.

A three-year-old boy is currently in critical condition after falling from a first-floor window in Rochdale. Emergency services were called to Spotland Tops in the Cutgate area shortly after 4.15pm on Saturday, August 22.

The boy was taken to hospital following the incident, where he remains under medical care. An air ambulance was also deployed to the scene to assist with the emergency response.

In connection with the incident, Greater Manchester Police (GMP) have arrested two women, aged 19 and 20, on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child. The arrests took place at an address in Blackburn, Lancashire, on Sunday, August 23.

GMP stated that inquiries into the full circumstances surrounding the incident are ongoing. Further updates are expected as the investigation progresses.

articles.title: Child in critical condition after fall from window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale
articles.excerpt: A boy has been seriously injured after falling from a window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale. He is currently in a critical condition in hospital as police investigate the incident.
articles.content_html:
A boy has been seriously injured after falling from a window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale. Emergency services were called to the scene at 16:16 BST on Saturday, August 22, 2026, following reports of concern for the welfare of a child.

The child was taken to hospital for treatment, where he remains in a critical condition. Greater Manchester Police have confirmed that inquiries into the full circumstances surrounding the incident are ongoing.

Authorities have not released further details regarding the child's age or the specific location of the incident within Spotland Tops. The police are working to establish the events leading up to the fall.

Local residents are urged to remain vigilant and report any information that may assist the investigation to the police.
